forceProject setting (+ /ls forceProject on|off, i18n cs/en, README) so an unusual layout or this plugin repo can be treated as a Domino project; enabled in .pi/lotusscript-modular.json here #done

Borrow worth-having ideas from NotesDominoExpert_V0.6.7.jsx into pi-lotusscript-modular: (1) target-Domino-version config key (`/ls config set dominoVersion`) injected into guidelines so advice can version-gate (oracle is fixed 9.0.1 but deployment target may be 12/14); (2) deterministic pre-check heuristic lane like the JSX `runCodeHeuristics` (missing Option Declare advisory, lookup-in-loop N+1 detector) feeding the scorecard as advisory items; (3) uncertainty-marking convention ("🔬 Not verified:") for rarely-documented APIs in the skill guidelines. Not adoptable: German-only UI (violates cs/en i18n contract), 14.5.1 KNOWN_LS_CLASSES hallucination-checker (redundant — the 9.0.1 compiler oracle already rejects unknown classes), direct Anthropic fetch architecture.
